note: Salted sha256 of lower-case terms that must never appear in the repo. Empty on purpose: a salted hash of a short term can be brute-forced, so the maintainers' own terms (names, client folders, account aliases) live in the git-ignored .secrets-denylist.local, one per line (plain, or sha256:<hash> from --hash), and in CI in the repository secret SECRETS_DENYLIST.
